name: crt_rand
description: The C runtime rand(): the sequence from state 1 and after srand(12345); random_shuffle of [0..9] from state 1 gives [8, 1, 9, 2, 0, 5, 7, 3, 4, 6] with exactly 9 calls, and makes no call for 0 or 1 elements. (The prime-step random cell iterator of §12.4 is not covered: its definition is in the weather spec.)
